caller_is_owner.meaning: the caller of increaseLiquidityCurrentRange() is the onlyOwner authority

held_duration_exceeds_deadline.meaning: the MEV bot holds the increaseLiquidityCurrentRange() transaction past the caller-provided deadline (report gives illustrative holds of 1 hour, 1 day, 1 week, 1 month) and the transaction still executes
held_duration_exceeds_deadline.checkpoint: at execution of the held increaseLiquidityCurrentRange() transaction

assumptions: The increaseLiquidityCurrentRange() call is made by the onlyOwner authority as stated in the report.
The deadline is caller-provided in the intended design; the report's root cause (hardcoded block.timestamp) is not encoded as P.

unresolved.description: Report gives no concrete caller-provided deadline value or numeric hold threshold; the indefinite-hold effect is stated qualitatively with illustrative durations (1 hour, 1 day, 1 week, 1 month) and no comparator, so the temporal relation is carried as a grounded Boolean.

limitations: Only the indefinite-hold impact is formalized; expiration-disabled, MEV profit and financial-loss impacts are handled in separate passes.
The held-duration Boolean abstracts the report's illustrative durations because no numeric deadline or comparator is stated.
Code-level binding of the deadline parameter and Uniswap increaseLiquidity() call is deferred.
